Package app.swea2

Class UserStore

java.lang.Object
app.swea2.UserStore
class UserStore extends Object
File-based persistence layer for User records and their associated Transaction data.

Users are stored as a JSON array in users.json. Transactions are stored per-user in transactions_&lt;userId&gt;.json. All I/O uses a hand-rolled JSON serialiser/deserialiser to avoid external library dependencies.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public static void load()
      Loads all users from users.json into the in-memory list. Subsequent calls are no-ops (idempotent guard via loaded flag).

    • save

      public static void save()
      Persists the full user list to users.json and then calls saveTransactions(User) for every user.

    • saveTransactions

      public static void saveTransactions(User user)
      Saves the given user's transaction list to transactions_&lt;userId&gt;.json.
      Parameters:
      user - the user whose transactions should be persisted

    • loadTransactions

      public static void loadTransactions(User user)
      Loads persisted transactions for the given user from transactions_&lt;userId&gt;.json, replacing any in-memory entries to avoid duplicates on re-login.
      Parameters:
      user - the user whose transactions should be loaded

    • register

      public static boolean register(String name, String email, String password, String currency)
      Registers a new user account.
      Parameters:
      name - display name
      email - unique email address
      password - plain-text password (stored as-is; hash in production)
      currency - preferred currency code (e.g. "USD")
      Returns:
      true if registration succeeded; false if the email is already taken

    • authenticate

      public static User authenticate(String email, String password)
      Authenticates a user by email and password. On success, persisted transactions are loaded into the returned object.
      Parameters:
      email - the user's email address
      password - the user's password
      Returns:
      the matching User, or null if credentials are invalid

    • getAll

      public static List<User> getAll()
      Returns an unmodifiable view of all registered users.
      Returns:
      read-only list of User objects

    • updateUserSettings

      public static boolean updateUserSettings(User user, String newName, String newEmail, String newCurrency, String newPassword)
      Updates the profile settings for an existing user and persists the change. Implements the sequence-diagram step: updateUserSettings(data) → Database.
      Parameters:
      user - the live User session object to update
      newName - new display name (null to keep existing)
      newEmail - new email address (null to keep existing)
      newCurrency - new currency code (null to keep existing)
      newPassword - new password (null or blank to keep existing)
      Returns:
      true on success; false if newEmail is already registered to a different account
